The files X01 and X02 both fall under severity 1, and I should refer to `.github/workflows` for citations. I'll utilize the CI file to find evidence of missing branch protection. For severity 2, I have findings regarding unfulfilled requirements. I think separating the severity orders will clarify the impact definitions better.**Identifying severities for findings**
